consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bringing back, inhale while opening.
consignes.Posture: Back supported, abs engaged, pelvis stable.

tendons_solicites: Tendon of the tensor fascia lata
contraintes: Do not peel off the back of the file
Check the opening to avoid jerks

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the machine, legs squeezed inside the cushions, back well supported.
consignes.Mouvement: Spread your legs against the resistance to your comfortable range.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, controlling the closure.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while moving away, inhale while returning.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis fixed, abs engaged.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in a quadrupedal position, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch one leg back and up without arching.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly without completely resting the knee.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, engaged abs, gaze towards the ground.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Place the elastic around the ankles, maintain stable support.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch one leg backwards against the resistance of the elastic.
consignes.Retour: Bring back without completely placing your foot on the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when extending, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, engaged abs, stable pelvis.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back
Control the trajectory of the foot

consignes.Positionnement: Secure the strap to the ankle, facing the pulley, hold on to a support.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your leg backwards against resistance, keeping your knee slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Bring the leg back without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, tight abs, fixed pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Place your foot on the rear support, hands on the handles, chest slightly inclined.
consignes.Mouvement: Push backwards until almost full extension without arching.
consignes.Retour: Bring the foot back without completely releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Back braced, pelvis aligned, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot in the TRX strap, in quadrupedal position, knees on the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend the leg in the TRX backwards until fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Bring your knee forward without resting on the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when extending, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, engaged abs, gaze towards the ground.

T072.nom: Kick back with weight (ankle brace or dumbbell)
contraintes: Do not force the amplitude if the weight is high

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on all fours or stand with support, weight attached or propped behind the knee.
consignes.Mouvement: Push your leg backwards by contracting your glutes, without arching.
consignes.Retour: Come back in control without touching the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Stable trunk, straight pelvis, gaze at the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Place your hands on a wall at shoulder height, feet hip width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Move one straight leg back behind you without going up too much, contracting your glutes.
consignes.Retour: Bring back without laying completely.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abdominals engaged, shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: On all fours, knees under hips, hands under shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise one leg laterally bent to 90°, keeping the pelvis fixed.
consignes.Retour: Go back down without completely resting your knee.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, engaged abs, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Place a mini elastic around the thighs, a few centimeters above the knees.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise one leg laterally bent to 90°, keeping constant tension in the elastic.
consignes.Retour: Bring back gently without putting your knee down.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, active core, relaxed shoulders.

contraintes: Keep the pelvis well fixed despite the weight

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself on all fours with a weight (ankle brace or dumbbell) on the leg being worked.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise the bent leg laterally to the comfortable amplitude.
consignes.Retour: Bring back slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Stable trunk, fixed pelvis, gaze towards the ground.

contraintes: Maintain balance without moving your trunk
Do not turn the hip outwards

consignes.Positionnement: Stand, hold on to support if necessary. Bend one leg slightly and raise the other to the side, knee bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform a lateral knee opening while maintaining chest alignment.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position without resting your foot.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you open, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, stable pelvis, engaged abdominals.

contraintes: Keep the pelvis parallel to the ground

consignes.Positionnement: Place both feet in the TRX straps in a quadrupedal position, knees in the air, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Open one bent knee laterally, keeping the hips stable.
consignes.Retour: Bring back slowly without losing alignment.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Abs engaged, back flat, gaze at the ground.

contraintes: Master balance before increasing the intensity

consignes.Positionnement: Place hands or knees on an unstable support in quadrupedal position.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise one leg bent laterally while maintaining core stability.
consignes.Retour: Bring back slowly without losing your balance.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Trunk engaged, gaze at the ground, pelvis aligned.

T080.nom: Fire Hydrant against a wall or staircase
contraintes: Align the pelvis well despite the angle

consignes.Positionnement: Place your hands on a wall or your knees on an elevated step.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise one leg bent laterally like a classic fire hydrant.
consignes.Retour: Bring back without putting down and maintain stability.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Abs engaged, back neutral, gaze towards the ground.

contraintes: Do not go too low to protect the shoulders
Keep your back close to the bench

consignes.Positionnement: Sit at the edge of the bench with your hands flat on either side of your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Slide your glutes forward and bend your elbows to a maximum of 90°.
consignes.Retour: Push back until arms are extended without completely locking.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, shoulders lowered.

contraintes: Do not go too low to protect the shoulders

consignes.Positionnement: Place your hands on the edge of a bench behind you, your heels on a second bench in front.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows up to 90°, keeping your glutes close to the bench.
consignes.Retour: Push back until arms are extended without completely locking.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis stable, shoulders lowered.

contraintes: Do not go below the shoulders if there is pain

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the bars, arms straight, shoulders down.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower yourself, bending your elbows to 90° or a little more.
consignes.Retour: Push powerfully to return with straight arms.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, legs slightly bent backwards.

contraintes: Do not relax your lower back under the load

consignes.Positionnement: Hang the weight on the belt, hang with your arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend slowly, controlling the load, to 90° or more.
consignes.Retour: Push back with power without jerks.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Total gain, looking forward.

contraintes: Difficult stability, requires sheathing and control

consignes.Positionnement: Stand in the hanging straps, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower slowly, keeping your elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Push up while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Slightly leaning torso, tight abdominals, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on the machine or insert an elastic band under your knees.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down slowly, bending your elbows, until you reach a controlled range.
consignes.Retour: Push back smoothly by contracting the triceps.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Stable trunk, low shoulders, neutral gaze.

contraintes: Do not flex your elbows too much to avoid shoulder discomfort

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor, hands behind your hips, fingers facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your hips slightly and bend your elbows 90° without touching the floor.
consignes.Retour: Push the floor back until your arms are extended.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, gaze forward.

contraintes: Keep your elbows close to your body
Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the pulley, feet hip-width apart, firm grip on the handle or rope.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arms down, keeping your elbows tight and fixed.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring back to a 90° angle at the elbows.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, hold the rope with your palms facing each other, elbows tight against your chest.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the rope down, spreading the ends slightly at the end of the movement.
consignes.Retour: Control the rise up to 90° at the elbow.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the rise.
consignes.Posture: Abs engaged, back straight, shoulders relaxed.

contraintes: Control the movement to avoid rotation of the torso

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself facing the pulley, handle in hand, elbow bent 90° close to your body.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arm downward until fully extended, without lifting your elbow.
consignes.Retour: Bring back slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, shoulders relaxed, abs engaged.

contraintes: Keep your wrists in line with the bar
Avoid moving your elbows while performing

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the EZ bar attached to the high pulley, overhand grip at shoulder width.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to approximately 90° at the elbows.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, elbows close to the body, abdominals engaged.

contraintes: Keep your elbows fixed and close to your body

consignes.Positionnement: Tie the elastic at shoulder height. Hold it with both hands or one hand, arm flexed at 90°.
consignes.Mouvement: Straighten your arm by pushing the elastic downward or forward depending on the angle.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, shoulders low.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
consignes.Retour: Come back up by contracting the triceps without locking the elbows.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, elbows pointed upwards.

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot on the elastic and hold the other end above your head with your elbows bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch your arms upward while keeping your elbows fixed.
consignes.Retour: Slowly go back down behind your head.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the descent.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, gaze forward.

contraintes: Control the descent to avoid jerks

consignes.Positionnement: With your back to the low pulley, hold the rope behind your head with your elbows bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Stretch your arms overhead until fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, feet apart, active core.

contraintes: Keep the arm vertical and stable

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, arm extended overhead.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
consignes.Retour: Straighten your arm while contracting your triceps.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you extend.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, elbows pointing upwards.

contraintes: Keep the elbow fixed during the movement

consignes.Positionnement: Resting on a bench or standing, torso leaning, dumbbell in hand, arm bent at 90°.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arm backwards, keeping your elbow still.
consignes.Retour: Gently return to initial position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, aligned neck, engaged abs.

contraintes: Do not relax the core sheathing

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot on the elastic, hold the other end in hand, bust leaned forward, elbow bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arm backwards until fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pushing, inhale while coming back.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abdominals contracted, gaze at the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Leaning on a bench or leaning forward, handle in hand, arm bent at 90°.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your arm backwards until fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, core core, gaze towards the ground.

contraintes: Keep both elbows fixed and aligned

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms bent, chest leaning.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend both arms simultaneously backwards.
consignes.Retour: Return to the starting position without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, gaze towards the ground, abdominals engaged.

T101.nom: Triceps extension using TRX or rings
contraintes: Master the angle of inclination to manage the difficulty
Keep your elbows aligned and close to your body

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the handles, arms extended in front of you, body tilted forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to lower your forehead toward your hands, then straighten your arms to return.
consignes.Retour: Return to the initial position without releasing the sheathing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you extend.
consignes.Posture: Shaved body, straight back, contracted abs, tight elbows.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise the dumbbells to your shoulders without moving your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, feet hip-width apart.

contraintes: Keep your elbows close to your body

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise one arm at a time to the shoulder, alternating arms.
consignes.Retour: Go back down, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, legs slightly bent.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on an inclined bench (~45°), a dumbbell in each hand, arms relaxed alongside the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower to full extension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back pressed to the bench, shoulders fixed, gaze straight.

contraintes: Keep the arm fixed throughout the movement

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, legs apart, elbow of the working arm placed on the inside of the thigh.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise the dumbbell towards the shoulder while contracting the biceps.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, gaze towards the dumbbell, shoulders relaxed.

contraintes: Do not lock your elbows at the bottom of the movement

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, feet hip width apart, bar held in pronation (palms up).
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the bar to your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs contracted, gaze straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, hold the EZ bar supinated (palms up), intermediate grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the bar toward your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Come back down, controlling the movement without locking your elbows.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, feet hip width apart, abs engaged.

contraintes: Do not release tension at the bottom of the movement

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the desk, arms placed against the support, supinated grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the load towards your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Lower slowly without locking your elbows.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, arms well supported, gaze fixed.

contraintes: Do not swing your upper body

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs (neutral grip).
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the dumbbells while maintaining your hammer grip.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, elbows close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the handles supinated, arms extended in front of you, body tilted backwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to bring your hands closer to your forehead, keeping your elbows fixed.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling, inhale while releasing.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, straight back, gaze towards the TRX attachment.

consignes.Positionnement: Attach a handle to the low pulley. Hold it with both hands supinated, arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows to raise the handle towards your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, feet anchored, abdominals engaged.

contraintes: Do not relax the trunk posture

consignes.Positionnement: Place the elastic under the feet, hold each end supinated, arms extended alongside the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your hands to your shoulders, bending your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Go back down, controlling the resistance of the elastic.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, feet anchored, abdominals engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the rings supinated, arms extended in front of you, body tilted backwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull with biceps to bring hands closer to forehead, elbows high.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Body tight, glutes and abs contracted, look towards the attachment.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, forearms resting on your thighs, wrists sticking out slightly with palms facing down.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform a wrist extension by lifting the dumbbells upwards.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, controlling the descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Keep your back straight and your shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing up, wrists outside your knees.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the dumbbells by opening your fingers slightly, then close and flex your wrists to raise the weights.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Keep your torso straight and your forearms stable on your thighs.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a light dumbbell at one end to create leverage, arm at your sides, elbow bent at 90°, wrist neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly rotate your wrist inward (pronation), then outward (supination).
consignes.Retour: Return to center between each rotation.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly while performing.
consignes.Posture: Keep your forearm stable and your torso straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, forearms resting on your thighs, wrists past your knees, palms down, holding a barbell.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise the bar by bending your wrists upward.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower back down to maximum amplitude.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Keep your torso straight, shoulders relaxed, arms fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or stand with your forearms resting on a surface or held steady, palms down, an elastic band under the foot and the other end held in your hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the elastic by lifting your hand upwards, only by the wrist.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position, controlling tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Keep your shoulders relaxed and your arm fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand in front of a low pulley, handle held pronated (palm down), elbow flexed at 90°, wrist at hip height.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your hand by bending only the wrist upwards.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position without letting it fall.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when bending, inhale when releasing.
consignes.Posture: Forearm fixed, shoulder relaxed, torso straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing up, wrists above your knees, holding a barbell.
consignes.Mouvement: Let the bar go down by opening your fingers slightly, then close your fingers and flex your wrists to raise it.
consignes.Retour: Control the descent until full extension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Keep your torso straight, shoulders relaxed, and forearms well positioned.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or stand with the elastic under your foot. Grasp the other end, palm facing up.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the elastic by bending your wrist towards you.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position, controlling tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when flexing, inhale when extending.
consignes.Posture: Forearm stable, shoulder relaxed, gaze straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself in front of a low pulley, handle held supinated (palm up), elbow flexed at 90°, wrist at hip height.
consignes.Mouvement: Flex your wrist to pull the handle toward you without moving your forearm.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without jerks.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you flex, inhale as you relax.
consignes.Posture: Forearm fixed, shoulder relaxed, torso straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the bar with both hands in pronation, arms bent at 90°, elbows close to the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate the bar slowly, alternating pronation and supination of the wrists.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position at the end of each movement.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly, inhale returning to neutral.
consignes.Posture: Keep your shoulders low and your core engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Attach an elastic band at wrist height, grasp the end while keeping the elbow glued to the body and the wrist neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate the wrist outward (supination) then inward (pronation) against resistance.
consignes.Retour: Return the wrist to a neutral position between each movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rotate, inhale as you return to neutral.
consignes.Posture: Forearm stable, shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the straps in a supinated position, body tilted backwards, arms extended in front of you, feet on the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Pulling lightly, contract your forearms to flex your wrists and bring your palms closer to your face without bending your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while contracting, inhale while releasing.
consignes.Posture: Body well aligned, abdominals and glutes contracted, gaze towards the anchor point.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the straps in pronation, arms extended in front of you, body tilted backwards.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your wrists slightly upwards while keeping your arms straight, a subtle and controlled movement.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the effort, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Maintain good alignment, abdominals and glutes contracted, shoulders low.

contraintes: Do not compensate with the shoulders or back

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a load in each hand, arms extended alongside the body, shoulders low, gaze straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk slowly and in a controlled manner for a set distance.
consignes.Retour: Turn around or put down loads after each round trip.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly throughout the exercise.
consignes.Posture: Keep your abs strong, back straight, neck aligned, wrists firm.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp two flat discs (or a block) between your thumb and fingers, arms at your sides.
consignes.Mouvement: Hold the load as long as possible without letting it slip.
consignes.Retour: Release slowly once the time is up.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe regularly without blocking.
consignes.Posture: Keep your shoulders low, back straight, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Wrap a towel over a pull-up bar, grip each end firmly.
consignes.Mouvement: Hang yourself while keeping your arms straight, your body relaxed or braced depending on the variation.
consignes.Retour: Release carefully by putting your feet down or gently descending.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and calmly during exercise.
consignes.Posture: Keep shoulders engaged, avoid swinging.

contraintes: Do not engage the shoulder unnecessarily

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a long, asymmetrical object (maul, clubbell) at one end, arm alongside the body or bent depending on the difficulty.
consignes.Mouvement: Hold the position without dropping or turning the object. You can also do it with your arms outstretched in front of you for more intensity.
consignes.Retour: Rest gently after each set or change of hands.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe regularly, avoid blocking your breathing.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, stable elbow, firm grip without tension.

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the TRX rings or handles with a neutral grip, arms extended in front of you, body tilted back.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly rotate your wrist from neutral to supination, then to pronation, without flexing your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when rotating, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, abs and glutes contracted, gaze towards the anchor point.

contraintes: Do not tense your shoulders unnecessarily

consignes.Positionnement: Grip a pull-up bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders, palms facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Allow the body to hang freely while keeping the arms straight.
consignes.Retour: Place your feet on the floor or slowly release at the end of the set.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe deeply and regularly.
consignes.Posture: Body relaxed, legs relaxed or crossed, shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a load in one hand, arm extended alongside your body, shoulders aligned.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk slowly and in a controlled manner for a set distance (10 to 30 m).
consignes.Retour: Change hands each set to balance the sides.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly throughout the walk.
consignes.Posture: Strengthen your abs and avoid any sideways tilt of your bust.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back
Keep arms locked at the top

consignes.Positionnement: Press the load overhead, arms straight, shoulders engaged, wrists aligned.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk slowly for a set distance (10 to 30 m), keeping the load above you stable.
consignes.Retour: Lower the load after the distance covered, change arms if necessary.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply during exercise.
consignes.Posture: Well-trained trunk, glutes engaged, gaze forward.

contraintes: Do not rise above the shoulders

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms facing your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms sideways until horizontal, elbows slightly bent, palms facing the floor.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower your arms, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Straight torso, engaged abs, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench, a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms towards your thighs.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms sideways until horizontal, elbows slightly bent, palms facing the floor.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight against the backrest, abs engaged, feet anchored to the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself next to the pulley, handle in the outside hand, arms at your sides.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arm sideways until horizontal, palm facing the floor.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Core core, shoulders aligned, do not lean.

consignes.Positionnement: Secure an elastic band under one foot, hold the other end in the opposite hand, arm at your side.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arm sideways until horizontal, palm facing the floor.
consignes.Retour: Go back down, controlling the resistance.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Straight torso, engaged abs, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handles pronated, body tilted back, arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Spread your arms sideways, maintaining tension and keeping your arms almost straight.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring your arms back in front of you, controlling.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Body straight, abs and glutes engaged, gaze towards the attachment.

contraintes: Do not lock your elbows suddenly

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward, feet hip-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the dumbbells upward until the arms are almost straight overhead.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Hold the trunk, look straight, shoulders low at the end of the movement.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on a bench with a backrest, dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, gaze fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Place the bar at collarbone level, grip slightly wider than the shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the bar upwards until your arms are almost fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position without hitting the collarbone.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Hold the trunk, legs slightly bent, gaze straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the machine, back against the backrest, handles at shoulder level.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the handles upwards until your arms are almost fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back well supported, feet flat on the ground, trunk braced.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the dumbbells in front of you at shoulder height, palms facing your body, elbows bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate your wrists while pushing the dumbbells upwards to finish with your arms straight, palms facing forward.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position by reversing the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Well-fitted trunk, straight back, gaze forward.

contraintes: Securely anchor the elastic under the feet
Master the end of the movement

consignes.Positionnement: Place the elastic under your feet, hold each end at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Push your arms up until almost fully extended.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, core core, shoulders aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX handles/rings, arms extended in front of you, body tilted forward, feet on the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your arms to lower your torso between your hands, then push to return to the starting position.
consignes.Retour: Control the descending phase, go back up while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, abs and glutes contracted, gaze towards the attachment.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, torso leaning forward, back flat, arms extended toward the floor, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms sideways until horizontal, elbows slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, gaze towards the ground, abs contracted to avoid rounding.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit at the edge of a bench, hold the dumbbells with your arms extended towards the floor, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms out to the sides until horizontal, elbows slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Lower your arms slowly without resting.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Leaning torso, flat back, feet firmly on the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Secure the elastic under your feet or behind you, grab the ends with your arms straight down.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms out to the sides until horizontal, palms facing the floor, elbows slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly, maintaining resistance.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, engaged abs, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handle with the hand opposite the pulley, chest slightly bent, arm extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arm out to the side until horizontal, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, pelvis stable, gaze towards the ground.

contraintes: Do not pull with your back

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a handful in each hand, arms crossed in front of you, palms facing in, slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Spread your arms back and out to the sides, maintaining the same bend in the elbows.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position without releasing the tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, feet anchored to the ground, abs engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX handles or rings with your arms straight in front of you, body tilted back, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Spread your arms out to the sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Return the arms to the initial position without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale when opening, exhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Core body, glutes and abdominals engaged, fluid movement.

T153.nom: External rotation with elastic (elbow to body)

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the elastic in the hand opposite the anchor, arm bent at 90°, elbow glued to the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your forearm outwards, keeping your elbow fixed against your side.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you open, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, abs engaged, pelvis stable.

T154.nom: Internal rotation with elastic (elbow to body)

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the elastic in your hand on the anchor side, arm bent at 90°, elbow glued to the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the forearm inward, keeping the elbow fixed against the side.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the rotation, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Straight body, engaged abs, low shoulders.

T155.nom: External rotation at the pulley (elbow to the body)
contraintes: Do not go too far in rotation

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handle in the hand opposite the pulley, arm bent at 90°, elbow glued to the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate the forearm outward until aligned with the shoulder.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you open, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Straight body, low shoulders, gaze forward.

T156.nom: Internal rotation at the pulley (elbow to body)

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handle in your hand on the same side as the pulley, arm bent at 90°, elbow against your side.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the forearm inward without lifting the elbow.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the rotation, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, stable shoulders, engaged abdominals.

consignes.Positionnement: The arm is raised to the side at 90°, elbow flexed at 90°, shoulder low.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform an external rotation by moving your hand away from the ground, without moving your arm in space.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during external rotation, inhale on return.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, stable shoulder blades, fixed gaze.

T158.nom: External rotation at the pulley (arm raised)
contraintes: Do not move the shoulder blade

consignes.Positionnement: Position yourself facing the high pulley, arm raised to 90° abduction, elbow flexed to 90°, palm facing the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Externally rotate the shoulder to bring the forearm upward.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position without releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Stable shoulder blade, straight torso, engaged abdominals.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handles with your arms extended in front of you, body tilted back, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Externally rotate your arms by opening them sideways (like a spinning bird).
consignes.Retour: Slowly return with your arms outstretched in front of you, controlling your descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, tight shoulder blades, low shoulders, gaze towards the attachment.

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a handstand position, hands shoulder-width apart, arms extended, feet against the wall if necessary.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your arms to slowly lower yourself until your head almost touches the floor.
consignes.Retour: Push back hard on your hands to return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Shaved body, neutral gaze, contracted abs and glutes.

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt an inverted V position, hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, legs straight, hips up.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your arms to lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
consignes.Retour: Push hard on your arms to return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, vertical movement, do not round the back.

consignes.Positionnement: Place your feet on a box, hands on the ground shoulder width apart, pelvis above your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower your head to the ground, bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Push hard to return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Core core, gaze towards the ground, hips aligned above the shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Install an elastic band hung high up, pass it around the waist or hips in an inverted position.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your head towards the ground by bending your arms, the elastic supports you as you rise.
consignes.Retour: Push back to return to the top position with control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, abs contracted, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand in a handstand against a wall, arms extended, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly bend your arms to lower your head toward the floor.
consignes.Retour: Push to return to the starting position, maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, gaze between the hands, stable shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
consignes.Mouvement: Shrug your shoulders toward your ears while keeping your arms straight.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Straight gaze, straight back, engaged abs.

consignes.Positionnement: High plank position, hands under shoulders, feet apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Touch the opposite shoulder with one hand while keeping the pelvis stable.
consignes.Retour: Rest your hand and alternate with the other.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in a neutral position, exhale with each tap.
consignes.Posture: Well aligned body, contracted abs, fixed pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: High plank position on the knees, hands under the shoulders, trunk well aligned.
consignes.Mouvement: Touch the opposite shoulder with one hand while keeping the pelvis stable.
consignes.Retour: Rest your hand and alternate with the other.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in a neutral position, exhale with each tap.
consignes.Posture: Shaved body, engaged abdominals, fixed pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: High plank position, with a weighted vest, hands under shoulders, trunk aligned.
consignes.Mouvement: Touch the opposite shoulder with one hand while keeping the pelvis stable.
consignes.Retour: Rest your hand and alternate with the other.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in a neutral position, exhale with each tap.
consignes.Posture: Abs well engaged, pelvis stable, tempo control.

consignes.Positionnement: High plank position with feet on a Swiss ball, hands on the floor under the shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Touch the opposite shoulder with one hand while maintaining balance.
consignes.Retour: Rest your hand and alternate with the other, without rolling the ball.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in a neutral position, exhale with each tap.
consignes.Posture: Well-sheathed trunk, stable pelvis, gaze at the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, hold a barbell with your arms extended in front of your thighs, grip shoulder-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Shrug your shoulders toward your ears without bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, gaze ahead, core core.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand in the machine, arms at your sides, grip handles firmly.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your shoulders towards your ears without bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Body straight, gaze ahead, trunk contracted.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, hold a dumbbell in one hand, arm extended alongside the body, the other hand can rest on the hip or hold a support.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your shoulder from the side of the dumbbell towards your ear, without bending your arm.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly and control the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, stable pelvis, straight gaze.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on an elastic band, one end in each hand, arms at your sides.
consignes.Mouvement: Shrug your shoulders toward your ears, without bending your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly, without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, engaged abs, look ahead.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand, hold a kettlebell in each hand, arms extended alongside your body.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your shoulders towards your ears without bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Lower your shoulders slowly, without swinging the load.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, look forward, abs engaged.

contraintes: Do not pull beyond the chin

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, hold the bar in an overhand position, hands shoulder-width apart, arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar vertically, keeping your elbows above your wrists at chin level.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower the bar, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale while pulling up.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, shoulders low at the start, gaze straight ahead.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in pronation, arms extended in front of your thighs.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the dumbbells upwards, spreading your elbows slightly, to chin height.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly, keeping your shoulders low at the start.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom position, exhale on the rise.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, elbows above the wrists.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on the elastic, extremities in each hand, arms extended in front of your thighs.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull toward your chin, keeping your elbows above your wrists.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position, controlling the resistance.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, gaze straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Suspended on TRX or rings, body tilted, arms extended, palms facing you.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the body toward the handles, leading the elbows up and out.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Body covered, legs stretched or bent depending on the level.

contraintes: Maintain chest contact on the bench

consignes.Positionnement: Lie face down on an incline bench, dumbbells in each hand, arms extended toward the floor.
consignes.Mouvement: Shrug your shoulders towards your ears without bending your arms.
consignes.Retour: Lower your shoulders, controlling the descent.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Head in alignment with the spine, trunk stable on the bench.

contraintes: Do not shrug your shoulders excessively

consignes.Positionnement: Standing or in a plank, shoulders slightly raised, dumbbells or elastic band in tension.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the isometric contraction for the duration of the effort.
consignes.Retour: Release slowly after the allotted time.
consignes.Respiration: Continuous and controlled breathing during the contraction.
consignes.Posture: Straight trunk, symmetrical shoulders, engaged abs.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the pulley, rope grasped in pronation, arms extended at eye level.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the rope toward your face, pushing your elbows back.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, tightened shoulder blades, stable trunk.

consignes.Positionnement: Attach an elastic band at face height. Hold it with both hands pronated, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the elastic towards your face by spreading your elbows and tightening your shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release back to the initial position without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, horizontal gaze, active core.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Suspended, body tilted backwards, arms extended in front of you, handles pronated.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles toward your face, spreading your elbows and tightening your shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly, keeping your shoulders low and stable.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in starting position, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed body, head-pelvis alignment, total control.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a bar in pronation, lean your torso at approximately 45°, arms extended towards the ground.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar upwards, elbows pointing outwards and toward the ceiling.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower the bar while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in the lower position, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs contracted, neck aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing facing the low pulley, grasp the bar or rope with your arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handle upwards, spreading your elbows to shoulder height.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, abs engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang facing the straps, body tilted, arms extended in front of you, palms pronated.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your chest toward the handles by raising your elbows to the side.
consignes.Retour: Go back down while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Well aligned body, engaged abs, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed.
consignes.Mouvement: Without bending your arms, raise your chest slightly by pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release to return to passive suspension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while suspending, exhale while contracting.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, active sheathing, neck fixed.

contraintes: Bring your chin above the bar

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar in an overhand position with your hands spread slightly wider than your shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, contracting your lats.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower your arms to full extension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Body tight, legs straight or crossed, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar supinated (palms facing you), hands shoulder-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, strongly engaging your biceps.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower your arms to full extension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Well-fitted body, forward gaze, stable legs.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar with your palms facing each other, arms straight, hands shoulder-width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull yourself up until your chin is above the handles.
consignes.Retour: Go back down, controlling the movement until your arms are extended.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Shaved body, stable legs, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the TRX or rings, tilt the body back, arms straight, neutral grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your body towards the handles, keeping your elbows close to your chest.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Body covered, legs stretched or bent depending on the level.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang a rubber band from the bar, insert one knee or foot into the loop, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar, keeping a good core.
consignes.Retour: Go back down gently while maintaining control of the elastic.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, shoulders low at the start, gaze forward.

consignes.Positionnement: Attach a weight to a belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet, hang with your arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Total sheathing, low shoulders, neutral look.

consignes.Positionnement: Place your knees on the support or hold the handles depending on the model, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull until your chin is over the bar or handles.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, low shoulders, neutral gaze.

contraintes: Do not pull behind the neck

consignes.Positionnement: Sitting facing the pulley, legs wedged under the tubes, grasp the bar in pronation, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar toward your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back.
consignes.Retour: Lower the bar slowly, controlling the rise.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight or slightly inclined, chest out, abs engaged.

contraintes: Do not pull behind the neck
Keep your elbows close to your chest

consignes.Positionnement: Sitting facing the pulley, legs braced, grasp the bar supinated (palms facing you), arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your trunk.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release until fully extended.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the top, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight or slightly inclined, abs engaged, gaze straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Sitting at the pulley, knees locked under the tubes, hold the handle in a neutral grip, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handle toward your chest, keeping your elbows close to your chest.
consignes.Retour: Slowly come back with your arms straight, keeping the tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abdominals engaged, gaze fixed horizontally.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or stand with the elastic fixed at height, arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the elastic toward your chest or upper torso, elbows back.
consignes.Retour: Let the elastic come back under tension, arms straight.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, shoulders low, core engaged.

contraintes: Prop the thighs tightly under the sausages

consignes.Positionnement: Adjust the seat and the cushions for good support, grip the handles pronated or neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles towards the top of your chest while contracting your lats.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release until your arms are extended.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale during the pull.
consignes.Posture: Back straight or slightly inclined, shoulders low, gaze fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit facing the low pulley, knees slightly bent, arms extended in a neutral grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handle toward your abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Release slowly, keeping the tension constant.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs contracted, shoulders low.

contraintes: Do not shrug your shoulders while pulling

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the pulley, legs bent, arms extended in pronation.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar towards the top of the navel, bringing your elbows back.
consignes.Retour: Extend your arms slowly while maintaining control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Straight torso, engaged abs, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, flex the hips to lean the torso to 45°, bar held in pronation with arms outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar toward your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Release the bar without rounding your back.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, knees bent, trunk core.

contraintes: Shoulder stable at the end of the pull

consignes.Positionnement: Sit with your legs straight or place the elastic under your feet, arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles towards your stomach, bringing your elbows back.
consignes.Retour: Let the elastic come back, maintaining slight tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, active core, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit down, adjust the seat and wedges for good posture, arms extended forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles towards the bottom of the chest or the navel while contracting the back.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release until your arms are almost fully extended.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight or slightly inclined, shoulders low and fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Place one knee and one hand on a bench, with the other arm extended toward the floor with a dumbbell.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale while pulling up.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, neck aligned, abs engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand facing the pulley, hold the handle with one hand, arm straight, back straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handle towards your side, bringing your elbow back.
consignes.Retour: Return to the initial position without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Stable torso, engaged abs, active shoulder blades.

consignes.Positionnement: Secure the elastic under the foot or at a low point, hold one end with one hand, arm straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull toward the hip, bringing the elbow close to the body.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, engaged abs, fluid movement.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a single TRX or ring handle, arm straight, body tilted back.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the ring towards your side without turning your torso.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing, straight body, fixed gaze.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing with the bar on the ground, bend the hips and lean the torso to 45°, arms extended, grip pronated.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar toward your lower stomach, bringing your shoulder blades together.
consignes.Retour: Slowly go back down, keeping your back flat.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, engaged abs, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, supination grip (palms towards you), bust slightly bent (~30°), arms outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar toward your lower stomach, elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Lower the bar slowly, controlling the load.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale while pulling up.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed back, horizontal gaze, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, feet hip-width apart, torso leaning at 45°, dumbbells in each hand, arms outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the dumbbells toward your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Lower your arms slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale while pulling up.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, gaze towards the ground, abs engaged.

contraintes: Do not round your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Sit facing the pulley, feet braced, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handle towards your abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your chest.
consignes.Retour: Slowly come back with your arms straight, keeping the tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, fixed torso, engaged abs.

consignes.Positionnement: Hold a handle in each hand, arms straight, body tilted back.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your chest toward the handles, keeping your elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale in the lower position, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing, straight bust, controlled movement.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit or hold the band under your feet with your arms extended in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the elastic toward your stomach, bringing your elbows back.
consignes.Retour: Gently release the elastic while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, shoulders low.

consignes.Positionnement: Adjust the seat and backrest for optimal alignment, arms extended forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles toward your lower torso, keeping your elbows close to your body.
consignes.Retour: Slowly release the load without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale with outstretched arms, exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Back braced, abs engaged, shoulders low.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie flat on your stomach, arms alongside your body or hands crossed under your forehead.
consignes.Mouvement: Simultaneously lift your chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Looking towards the ground, gluteal and lumbar support.

consignes.Positionnement: Position your pelvis at the edge of the cushion, feet locked, arms crossed over your chest or hands behind your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly lower your torso, then come back up in line with your legs.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, controlling the descent.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, head in alignment, active core.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie flat on your stomach, arms outstretched in front of you, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Simultaneously raise your arms, chest and legs off the ground.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly, keeping a slight core.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ground, abs engaged, controlled extension.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your stomach, attach the elastic to a low point and hold it behind your neck or shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Straighten your upper body against the resistance of the elastic.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale up.
consignes.Posture: Gaze at the ground, back aligned, contraction of the lower back.

contraintes: Back braced without forcing the amplitude

consignes.Positionnement: Adjust the machine so that your upper back is pressed against the backrest, legs braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Push your upper back against the backrest to tense your spine.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the initial position without jerking.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, look forward, abs engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor, hands crossed on your chest or behind your ears.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll up your torso by bringing your shoulders closer to your pelvis.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without resting your head completely.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ceiling, lower back in contact with the floor.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the right shoulder towards the left knee while rolling the torso.
consignes.Retour: Go back down without completely resting, then alternate.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ceiling, lower back in contact with the floor.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back with your knees bent, weight against your chest or arms extended toward the ceiling.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll your chest up to lift your shoulder blades off the ground, without pulling on your neck.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without completely resting your head.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Gaze upward, lower back pressed to the ground, abs engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the Swiss Ball, lower back tightly wrapped on the ball, feet on the ground, hands crossed or behind your head.
consignes.Mouvement: Contract your abs to roll your torso smoothly.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ceiling, ball stable, lower back supported.

contraintes: Do not pull with your arms

consignes.Positionnement: Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, hands at shoulder level.
consignes.Mouvement: Curl your torso towards the ground by contracting your abs, elbows towards your knees.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly without completely straightening your torso.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way down, inhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Slightly rounded back, no pulling with the arms, voluntary contraction.

contraintes: Lower back stuck to the ground

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms alongside your body or under your buttocks, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs straight to 90° without lifting your lower back.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly without placing your heels on the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Strong sheathing, gaze towards the ceiling, constant control.

T227.nom: Leg raises hanging from the bar

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar, arms straight, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs to horizontal or higher depending on mobility.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly without swinging.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Abs contracted, shoulders stable, pelvis fixed.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on an inclined bench, head up, arms behind your head or hanging on the handles.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your straight legs toward the ceiling.
consignes.Retour: Go down slowly without putting your heels down.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back glued to the bench, abs engaged, fluid movement.

contraintes: Back glued to the floor or bench

consignes.Positionnement: Lie down with the load fixed or held between the ankles, arms on the floor for stability.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs straight while maintaining the load.
consignes.Retour: Go down slowly without releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Back tight, strong core, slow movement.

T230.nom: Oblique leg raises on the floor

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side, legs straight, opposite hand on the floor for stability.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise both legs, keeping them together and straight, towards the ceiling diagonally.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly without stopping completely.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned to the side, abs engaged, fluid movement.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar, arms straight, legs slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs by bending them towards one side (left or right), contracting the obliques.
consignes.Retour: Slowly go back down and alternate sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed pelvis, low shoulders, controlled movement.

T232.nom: Oblique Leg Raises on Incline Bench

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on the incline bench, hold the handles behind your head, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs diagonally to one side, contracting your obliques.
consignes.Retour: Slowly go back down then alternate sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Fixed pelvis, straight legs, constant core.

contraintes: Do not round your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the ground, legs bent, feet on the ground or off depending on the level. Trunk slightly tilted back, back straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate your torso to the left then to the right, contracting your oblique abdominals. The movement should come from the trunk, not the arms.
consignes.Retour: Return to center between each rotation to maintain control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when rotating, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Keep your chest tight, look straight ahead. Do not arch your lower back.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor, legs bent, trunk slightly tilted back. Hold the medicine ball in both hands, close to your chest.
consignes.Mouvement: Rotate your torso from left to right, keeping the medicine ball close to your torso.
consignes.Retour: Come back to the center each time so as not to get carried away in the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when rotating, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, engaged abs, stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on the floor with your legs bent and off the ground. Trunk tilted back, arms extended or hands clasped in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your torso to the left then to the right without moving your legs.
consignes.Retour: Always come back through the center. Maintains lower body stability.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Straight back, fixed gaze, abdominals well engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit on an inclined bench, prop your feet up. Trunk tilted backwards, arms outstretched or holding a load.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your torso from left to right, keeping your core braced.
consignes.Retour: Control the return well, don't let gravity accelerate the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, gaze forward, abdominals contracted continuously.

consignes.Positionnement: Attach the elastic at bust height. Hold it with both hands, arms outstretched, facing the anchor point, in a standing or kneeling position.
consignes.Mouvement: Turn your trunk away from the elastic, keeping your arms straight, then slowly return.
consignes.Retour: Control the return well, maintain resistance.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the rotation, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Stable feet, fixed pelvis, covered trunk.

T238.nom: Abdominal wheel – knees on the floor

consignes.Positionnement: Kneel on a mat, place the abdominal wheel in front of you, hands on the handles, arms straight, back neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your arms straight and your core braced. Go down as far as you can without arching.
consignes.Retour: Return the wheel to the initial position by contracting your abs, without rounding your back.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Total trunk strength, neutral pelvis, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand, feet hip width apart, wheel on the ground in front of you. Bend over and grab the wheel with your arms outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll the wheel slowly forward until your body is almost parallel to the ground, legs straight.
consignes.Retour: Strongly contract your abs to return to standing while keeping your back neutral.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Full coverage, glutes engaged, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: On your knees, hands on the wheel, core covered. Orient the wheel diagonally to the right.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll the wheel at an angle to target the left side of the abs. Come back to the center.
consignes.Retour: Then alternate by rolling to the left.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you go forward, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Sheathing maintained, pelvis stable, gaze towards the ground.

consignes.Positionnement: Kneel on a mat, face a wall about 1 meter away. Abdominal wheel in front of you.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll the wheel towards the wall until you touch it without impacting it. Take a time out.
consignes.Retour: Slowly bring the wheel towards you with abdominal control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while moving forward, exhale while returning.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged, do not arch your lower back.

consignes.Positionnement: Place your hands in the TRX straps/rings, knees on the ground or feet hanging, depending on the variation chosen.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll forward with your core while keeping your arms straight and your body aligned.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly, contracting your abs without losing trunk alignment.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while moving forward, exhale while returning.
consignes.Posture: Maximum stability, glutes and abdominals engaged, back straight.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your stomach, elbows under your shoulders, forearms on the floor. Raise your pelvis to align your head, trunk and legs.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain this static position by contracting your abs, glutes and thighs.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the expected time, then gently release.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe in a controlled manner without releasing the sheath.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ground, shoulder blades engaged, trunk well aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a push-up position with arms outstretched, hands under your shoulders, legs straight, resting on your toes.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain this static position by contracting your abdominals, glutes and thighs.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the expected time, then rest gently.
consignes.Respiration: Controlled breathing throughout the hold.
consignes.Posture: Gaze towards the ground, trunk well aligned, no lumbar hollow.

T245.nom: Unstable ventral sheathing (Swiss Ball / TRX / BOSU)

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt a plank position (on elbows or outstretched arms) with feet or elbows on an unstable support (Swiss Ball, BOSU, TRX).
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain posture without letting the body collapse, adjust micro-movements to maintain balance.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the allotted time then return slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, controlled breathing.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, trunk well engaged, no lumbar hollow.

T246.nom: Dynamic ventral cladding (walking: back and forth)

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a plank position with your arms outstretched or on your elbows, body well aligned.
