consignes.Mouvement: Performs a forward/backward walk with the hands or feet (e.g. inchworm, beast walk). The trunk remains contracted and stable.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to the starting position.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the movement, inhale on the way back.
consignes.Posture: Gaze at the ground, pelvis fixed, shoulders above the supports.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side, resting on one elbow and the outer edge of the foot. Aligns the legs, pelvis and shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your pelvis to create a straight line from head to toe. Hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the duration provided, then slowly lower back down.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly without releasing the sheath.
consignes.Posture: Head aligned, trunk contracted, pelvis stable.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your side, arm extended under your shoulder, support on your hand and the edge of your foot.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your pelvis and hold the position without misaligning your trunk.
consignes.Retour: Hold for the designated time, then slowly return to the ground.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe slowly while maintaining the posture.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis high, head in alignment, arm locked.

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a lateral sheathing position with your elbow or arm outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your upper leg upwards while keeping your pelvis stable.
consignes.Retour: Come back down slowly without losing alignment.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you raise your leg, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned, glutes and abs contracted, neutral gaze.

consignes.Positionnement: Classic lateral sheathing position on elbow or outstretched arm.
consignes.Mouvement: Move the pelvis up and down a few centimeters fluidly, or move forward/backward.
consignes.Retour: Return to neutral position each time.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while contracting, inhale while releasing.
consignes.Posture: Stay aligned, neutral gaze, core well engaged.

T251.nom: Lateral sheathing with instability (Swiss Ball / TRX / BOSU)

consignes.Positionnement: Place yourself in a lateral core position, resting on an unstable support (feet or forearms on Swiss Ball, BOSU or TRX straps).
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the position despite the instability by intensely contracting the trunk.
consignes.Retour: Maintain control and come back smoothly if necessary.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and deeply, without relaxing the posture.
consignes.Posture: Straight body, fixed gaze, solid support despite instability.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms extended behind your head, legs extended at ground level.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift your shoulders and heels off the ground. Contract your abs hard to maintain the hollow position.
consignes.Retour: Hold the position for the designated time, then gently release.
consignes.Respiration: Controlled breathing, diaphragmatic if possible.
consignes.Posture: Curved banana-shaped body line, gaze towards the knees, core engaged.

consignes.Positionnement: Lie on your back, arms alongside your body or in front, knees bent 90° above your hips.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift your shoulders and feet slightly, keeping your lower back glued to the floor.
consignes.Retour: Hold the intended static position.
consignes.Respiration: Short, regular breathing.
consignes.Posture: Compact body, look towards the thighs.

consignes.Positionnement: Adopt the hollow position, arms behind your head, legs straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Slowly rock your body back and forth while maintaining a hollow shape.
consignes.Retour: Control the pendulum well at each end.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe smoothly despite movement.
consignes.Posture: Toned body, tight abs, movement initiated by the trunk.

consignes.Positionnement: Hollow position with arms outstretched holding a load above the head.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintains the static position without the load changing the alignment.
consignes.Retour: Hold for the expected time then rest gently.
consignes.Respiration: Slow, controlled breathing.
consignes.Posture: Arms locked, abdominals engaged, trunk well stabilized.

consignes.Positionnement: Hang from a bar with your hands pronated. Raise your legs in front of you until you create a hollow shape.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the position with the trunk and legs well aligned.
consignes.Retour: Release gently after the scheduled time.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while rising, inhale while maintaining.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis retroverted, legs straight, shoulders active.

consignes.Positionnement: Choose a stable position (lying, sitting, or standing). Place one hand on your lower abdomen.
consignes.Mouvement: Exhale deeply through your mouth, completely empty your lungs, then draw your stomach in by sucking your navel towards your spine.
consignes.Retour: Hold the apnea for 5 to 15 seconds (depending on your level), then release and breathe normally.
consignes.Respiration: Exercise based on expiratory apnea. Do not force beyond your abilities.
consignes.Posture: Neutral spine, shoulders relaxed, lower abdomen engaged.

contraintes: Avoid in case of knee pain or patellofemoral pathologies

consignes.Positionnement: Back flat against the wall, feet shoulder-width apart, approximately 50 cm from the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your legs to 90°, thighs parallel to the ground, hold the position without moving.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly and regularly, avoid apnea.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs tight, knees aligned with the ankles.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.

contraintes: Avoid if imbalance or joint pain

consignes.Positionnement: Back pressed against the wall, one leg extended in front of you, the other at 90°.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe calmly without blocking your breathing.
consignes.Posture: Trunk covered, knee aligned with the ankle.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower until the knees are at about a 90-degree angle, then hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.

contraintes: Avoid in case of knee or lower back pain

consignes.Positionnement: Place the dumbbells on the thighs, maintain the classic chair position.
consignes.Posture: Abs contracted, back pressed against the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower until the knees are at about a 90-degree angle, then hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale during the setup or lowering phase, exhale during the effort.

position: Ball between the knees or in the hands
contraintes: Choose a suitable weight so as not to increase joint pressure

consignes.Positionnement: Ball held in front of you or between your knees.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs contracted.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower until the knees are at about a 90-degree angle, then hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale during the setup or lowering phase, exhale during the effort.

contraintes: Do not realize if Achilles tendon pain

consignes.Positionnement: Lift your heels off to engage your calves in addition to your quadriceps.
consignes.Posture: Maintain stability, abs contracted.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower until the knees are at about a 90-degree angle, then hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale during the setup or lowering phase, exhale during the effort.

contraintes: Choose a suitable elastic band so as not to unbalance your posture

consignes.Positionnement: Maintain the chair position by pushing your knees against the elastic.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs engaged.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower until the knees are at about a 90-degree angle, then hold the position.
consignes.Retour: Push through the heels to stand back up without abruptly losing posture.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale during the setup or lowering phase, exhale during the effort.

contraintes: Avoid in case of herniated disc or severe lower back pain

consignes.Positionnement: Feet hip width apart, bar close to the shins, hands pronated or mixed.
consignes.Mouvement: Push through your legs and contract your glutes to lift the bar.
consignes.Retour: Lower the bar while keeping your back straight, controlling the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before pulling, exhale at the top of the movement.
consignes.Posture: Back straight, abs tight, avoid lumbar flexion.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet hip width apart, dumbbells in front of thighs.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the dumbbells down your legs, pushing your hips back.
consignes.Retour: Contract your glutes and straighten your torso.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet wide apart, hands tight on the bar.
consignes.Mouvement: Push through your legs and contract your glutes to lift the bar.
consignes.Retour: Control the descent by keeping your back straight.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet hip width apart, bar in front of thighs.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, legs slightly bent.
consignes.Retour: Contract the glutes and hamstrings to return to standing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Place the kettlebell between the feet.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down while keeping your back straight, grab the kettlebell and push through your legs to come back up.
consignes.Retour: Control the descent.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet hip width apart, legs straight but not locked.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the bar while keeping your legs straight and your back flat.
consignes.Retour: Contract your hamstrings and glutes to return to standing.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand on a platform to increase the amplitude.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift the bar like a classic deadlift with more stretching.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly to the starting position while keeping the movement controlled.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Bar placed on a rack at knee height.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift the bar to a reduced amplitude.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly to the starting position while keeping the movement controlled.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand and hold the TRX straps.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your torso straight by pushing your hips backwards, then come back.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly to the starting position while keeping the movement controlled.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

consignes.Positionnement: Place the elastic under the feet, hold it with your hands.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the right torso then rise again by pulling on the elastic.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly to the starting position while keeping the movement controlled.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale before lowering, brace the core, then exhale as you lift the load.
consignes.Posture: Keep a neutral back, engaged shoulders and the load close to the body.

contraintes: Avoid very heavy loads in case of knee or lower back pain

consignes.Positionnement: Hold the handles high, arms outstretched, torso braced, trunk slightly tilted forward.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the sled in powerful, regular strides, active heel/forefoot.
consignes.Retour: Walk back and control your breathing.
consignes.Respiration: Rhythm on the effort (short and continuous breath).
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, pelvis in slight retroversion, gaze forward.

contraintes: Demanding on the trunk and shoulders; manage the load gradually

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the low handles, torso more inclined, feet active.
consignes.Mouvement: Push heavy and short, powerful strides, maintain the core.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly and prepare for the next set.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, stable shoulders, aligned neck.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Prioritize stride speed; keep the technique clean

consignes.Positionnement: High or low handles depending on comfort, light load.
consignes.Mouvement: Accelerate over a short distance (10–20 m) while maintaining control.
consignes.Retour: Walk back; actively recover.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.
consignes.Posture: Keep the torso solid, shoulders low and foot contacts active.

contraintes: Very safe for the knees but still controlled when reversing
variantes: Sled Pull – Front harness (running or walking)
Sled Pull – Hand to Hand Rope

consignes.Positionnement: Strap attached to the waist, walk back with controlled steps.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the sled in reverse, knees and hips bent.
consignes.Posture: High bust, covered trunk, active heel–toe.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

T278.nom: Sled Pull – Front harness (running or walking)
contraintes: Choose a load compatible with the target cadence
variantes: Sled Pull – Hand to Hand Rope

consignes.Positionnement: Harness on the torso/shoulders, sheathed trunk.
consignes.Mouvement: Run or walk while pulling the sled, regular strides.
consignes.Respiration: Regular, adapted to the effort.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Posture: Keep the torso solid, shoulders low and foot contacts active.

T279.nom: Sled Pull – Hand to Hand Rope
contraintes: Keep your back neutral; do not round when pulling hard
variantes: Sled Pull – Front harness (running or walking)

consignes.Positionnement: Anchor your feet, grab the rope in an alternate grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull hand to hand, bring the rope towards the chest, step back if standing.
consignes.Posture: Strong core, low shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Keep hips stable; no excessive trunk rotation

consignes.Positionnement: Attach the sled at waist level, stand sideways.
consignes.Mouvement: Move sideways while pulling the sled, with controlled steps.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, stable pelvis.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Keep your back neutral; avoid lumbar hyperextension
variantes: Sled Pull – Hand to Hand Rope
Sled Pull – Front harness (running or walking)

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the handles/rope with arms outstretched, feet anchored.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull towards the chest by bringing the elbows in, step back in control.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, trunk strong, gaze at the horizon.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Do not arch your lower back; keep your shoulders low

consignes.Positionnement: Straps at the hands/forearms, inclined bust.
consignes.Mouvement: Push forward while moving forward, arms extending.
consignes.Posture: Strong core, neutral pelvis, regular cadence.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

T283.nom: Sled Overhead Press (vertical push to the straps)
contraintes: Avoid heavy loads if shoulder pain; stay in pain

consignes.Positionnement: Straps held at shoulder level.
consignes.Mouvement: Push above the head while moving forward, arms outstretched at the end of the gesture.
consignes.Posture: Ribs tucked in, pelvis neutral, do not arch.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

position: Standing in profile at the sled
contraintes: Avoid lumbar twisting; move forward as a trunk-pelvis block

consignes.Positionnement: Stand sideways, hands on the handles, feet parallel.
consignes.Mouvement: Push laterally with sweeping steps, keeping your torso aligned.
consignes.Posture: Anti-rotation sheathing, low shoulders.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

position: In profile at the traction axis
contraintes: Rotation from the hips and trunk as a block; avoid isolated lumbar twist

consignes.Positionnement: From the side, grasp the rope with both hands at shoulder level.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull/guide the rope in controlled rotation like woodchopper.
consignes.Posture: Anti-extension sheathing, low shoulders, fluid weight transfer.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Avoid if shoulder or wrist pain

consignes.Positionnement: Place the straps on a low harness or on the hands, get into a quadrupedal position.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward in a crawl step, pulling the sled behind you.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, stable pelvis, avoid lumbar arch.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

position: Stand with arms alongside your body
contraintes: Protect the trunk well to avoid lateral tilting

consignes.Positionnement: Grasp the side handles of the sled, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk straight while maintaining the sheathing and load.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, low shoulders, tight core.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Avoid lateral imbalance; stabilize the pelvis

consignes.Positionnement: Place one foot forward (lunge), trunk straight, straps in hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform a unilateral pull or push while keeping the lunge.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, front knee aligned with ankle.
consignes.Retour: Slow down gradually, reset your footing and return to the start under control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe rhythmically and continuously throughout the push or pull.

contraintes: Avoid in case of lower back, shoulder or knee pain

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Come down into a squat, hands on the ground, send your feet back, then come back.
consignes.Retour: Bring your feet under your pelvis and come back upright, with or without jumping.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, neutral column, controlled reception.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your hands to the ground, move your feet back one by one, then come back.
consignes.Retour: Return to standing without jumping.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the ascent.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back and light sheathing.

contraintes: High impact, avoid in case of joint pain

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Classic burpee with explosive vertical jump at the end of the repetition.
consignes.Retour: Soft landing, knees bent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when jumping.
consignes.Posture: Active cladding and controlled reception.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower to the ground until chest contact, then return to standing.
consignes.Retour: Full extension at the end of the movement.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the ascent.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing, prevent lumbar sagging.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: After the burpee, perform an explosive long jump.
consignes.Retour: Stabilize the reception before moving on.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale during the impulse.
consignes.Posture: Align hips/knees/ankles upon landing.

contraintes: Height of the obstacle adapted to the level

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the obstacle.
consignes.Mouvement: Perform a burpee then overcome the obstacle by jumping or stepping.
consignes.Retour: Check receipt.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when crossing.
consignes.Posture: Active cladding and forward gaze.

contraintes: Stability upon reception and crossing standard

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the bar.
consignes.Mouvement: Burpee then lateral crossing of the bar.
consignes.Retour: Stabilize before next repetition.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with effort.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk and controlled reception.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Move your feet back one by one instead of jumping.
consignes.Retour: Return to standing without impulse.
consignes.Respiration: Smooth breathing.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back and core control.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, back pressed against the backrest, chest out, shoulders down.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring your arms together in front of your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly, controlling the opening without letting the shoulders move forward.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you approach, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Slightly tight shoulder blades, long neck, stable torso.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, hands in neutral grip if the machine allows it, torso fixed.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the handles together in front of your chest without completely extending your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to opening while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when closing, inhale when opening.
consignes.Posture: Stable shoulder blades, avoid rolling the shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Sitting, one hand works, the other stabilizes or remains at rest.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the active arm in front of the chest while keeping the torso still.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to control, without losing shoulder alignment.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you close, inhale as you return.
consignes.Posture: Lightweight sheathing to prevent rotation.

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the wall, feet shoulder width apart, medicine ball at sternum level.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down in a squat then come up explosively, throwing the ball towards the target.
consignes.Retour: Recover the ball, cushion and follow up with a controlled squat.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale during the push/throw.
consignes.Posture: Knees in line, active core, gaze towards the target.

contraintes: Avoid long strides if hip pain

consignes.Positionnement: Sandbag on the shoulder or bear-hug, feet hip width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Take a step forward and descend to approximately 90° on the front leg.
consignes.Retour: Push through the front heel and move forward with the back leg (walk sequence).
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Bust high, pelvis stable, front knee aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Sandbag tight against the chest (bear hug), elbows close to the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk in short, steady steps with your core braced.
consignes.Retour: Place the sandbag carefully, without excessively rounding your back.
consignes.Respiration: Breathe regularly, do not block.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, low shoulders, stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet hip width apart, kettlebell in front, torso inclined (hinge), back neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Hip back then explosive hip extension to throw the kettlebell.
consignes.Retour: Let it come down while controlling it, absorb it in a hinge (not with your arms).
consignes.Respiration: Exhale to extension, inhale back.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, active core, neutral neck.

consignes.Positionnement: Dumbbells in front rack (shoulders), feet stable.
consignes.Mouvement: Do a squat then come up explosively and push the dumbbells overhead.
consignes.Retour: Lower the dumbbells back to the front rack and continue.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale as you descend, exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Strong core, knees aligned, head neutral.

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the box, feet hip width apart, arms free.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend slightly and jump onto the box, raising your knees.
consignes.Retour: Go back down with control (not necessarily by jumping).
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on impulse, inhale on reception.
consignes.Posture: Stable reception, knees in line, chest covered.

contraintes: Controlled reception on the other side

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the box, comfortable distance for jumping.
consignes.Mouvement: Jump on the box then cross to the other side (jump or not depending on level).
consignes.Retour: Stabilize and continue with the next pass.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on impulse.
consignes.Posture: Active cladding, knees in line, downhill control.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet stable, knees slightly bent, rope in hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Alternate arms quickly to create regular waves.
consignes.Retour: Maintain a constant rhythm until the end of the time.
consignes.Respiration: Short, rhythmic breath during exercise.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, low shoulders, core core.

consignes.Positionnement: Medicine ball overhead, feet stable.
consignes.Mouvement: Throw the ball to the ground with force while engaging the trunk.
consignes.Retour: Recover and start again, keeping a controlled pace.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at the slam.
consignes.Posture: Active core, neutral back, hip/knee flexion during recovery.

consignes.Positionnement: Dumbbell on the ground between the feet, torso braced, back neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Explosive hip extension then pull and pass under the dumbbell to lockout overhead.
consignes.Retour: Lower the dumbbell to the ground while controlling, alternating arms.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the explosiveness, inhale back.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, trunk core, knees aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Light ball held in front of the chest, feet shoulder width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Controlled squat followed by a fluid push towards the target.
consignes.Retour: Cushion the reception of the ball.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, knees in line.

consignes.Positionnement: KB in front of you, neutral back.
consignes.Mouvement: Explosive hip extension to overhead lock.
consignes.Retour: Controlled hinge descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at extension.
consignes.Posture: Strong sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Bar in front rack.
consignes.Mouvement: Full squat followed by an overhead push.
consignes.Retour: Return the bar to the front rack.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pushing.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back.

consignes.Positionnement: Facing the box, feet hip width.
consignes.Mouvement: Place one foot on the box, transfer the weight and move to the other side.
consignes.Retour: Go down the other side in control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Straight torso, knee in line.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet stable, ropes in hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms and hit the ropes on the floor simultaneously.
consignes.Retour: Continue without breaking the rhythm.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with each slam.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Ropes in hand, arms slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Draw continuous circles with your arms.
consignes.Retour: Maintain the rhythm until the end.
consignes.Respiration: Rhythmic breathing.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, active sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Ball above shoulder.
consignes.Mouvement: Torso rotation and lateral projection on the ground.
consignes.Retour: Refocus and alternate sides.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at the projection.
consignes.Posture: Stable pelvis, oblique sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Heavy loads in hand, arms alongside the body.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk slowly and controlled.
consignes.Retour: Place loads without rounding your back.
consignes.Respiration: Short, controlled breathing.
consignes.Posture: High bust, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Load held on one side, torso straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk slowly without leaning your trunk.
consignes.Retour: Switch sides halfway through.
consignes.Respiration: Controlled breathing.
consignes.Posture: Active oblique sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Lunge position, straight torso.
consignes.Mouvement: Jump and invert legs in the air.
consignes.Retour: Controlled reception.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on impulse.
consignes.Posture: Knees in line.

consignes.Positionnement: Dumbbells on the floor, feet stable.
consignes.Mouvement: Burpee on dumbbells then explosive extension to push press.
consignes.Retour: Lower the dumbbells to the ground in control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, strong sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Hands under shoulders, knees off.
consignes.Mouvement: Move opposite arms and legs forward.
consignes.Retour: Maintain a smooth pace.
consignes.Respiration: Breathing continues.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back.

consignes.Positionnement: In plank, hands under shoulders.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower your chest to the ground, lift your hands then push.
consignes.Retour: Full arm extension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Between two plots spaced 5 to 20 meters apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Run to the block, touch the ground and leave.
consignes.Retour: Change direction in control.
consignes.Respiration: Rhythmic breathing.
consignes.Posture: Slightly leaning torso, dynamic support.

consignes.Positionnement: Feet pelvis width.
consignes.Mouvement: Jump as far forward as possible.
consignes.Retour: Stabilize reception.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on impulse.
consignes.Posture: Hips/knees aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, chest straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward in an alternating lunge.
consignes.Retour: Push into the front heel.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Reclined torso, neutral back.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull quickly then control the descent.
consignes.Retour: Full arm extension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on draw.
consignes.Posture: Tight shoulder blades.

consignes.Positionnement: Load overhead.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward in an alternating lunge.
consignes.Retour: Stabilize before each step.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Maximum gain.

consignes.Positionnement: Face the tire, hips low.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift then push the tire to turn it over.
consignes.Retour: Reposition before the next repetition.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with the explosion.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, leg push.

consignes.Positionnement: Tilted chest, bar with arms outstretched.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the bar explosively.
consignes.Retour: Controlled descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on draw.
consignes.Posture: Tight shoulder blades.

consignes.Positionnement: Load locked overhead.
consignes.Mouvement: Move forward in an alternating lunge.
consignes.Retour: Stabilize before each step.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Maximum gain.

consignes.Positionnement: Low hips, neutral back.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift then push the tire.
consignes.Retour: Reposition before next repetition.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale with the explosion.
consignes.Posture: Priority leg power.

consignes.Positionnement: Pump position facing the wall.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk with your feet toward the wall and your hands toward the back.
consignes.Retour: Get back down in control.
consignes.Respiration: Breathing continues.
consignes.Posture: Strict sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Lying, KB arm locked.
consignes.Mouvement: Getting back up step by step.
consignes.Retour: Go back down in the opposite direction.
consignes.Respiration: Slow breathing.
consignes.Posture: Look at the load.

consignes.Positionnement: Standing, feet pelvis width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower to the floor, pump, then full extension.
consignes.Retour: Get back upright without rushing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back.

contraintes: Do not round your upper back

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, back flat, elbows on the pads at chest level.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring your elbows together in front of you while contracting your pectorals.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly, controlling the opening without pulling on the shoulder.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bringing it closer, inhale while opening.
consignes.Posture: Chest out, shoulders low, neck long.

variantes: Spread pulley facing top to bottom
Spread pulley facing bottom to top

consignes.Positionnement: Pulleys at chest height, one foot in front, bust slightly inclined.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the handles together in front of your chest without locking your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Open with control until you feel the pectoral stretch.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bringing it closer, inhale while opening.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder blades tight, shoulders low.

T339.nom: Spread pulley facing top to bottom
variantes: Spread pulley facing bottom to top

consignes.Positionnement: Pulleys at the top, slight inclination of the bust.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring the handles down/center (navel line).
consignes.Retour: Go up slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bringing it closer, inhale while opening.
consignes.Posture: Strong sheathing, stable shoulder blades.

T340.nom: Spread pulley facing bottom to top
variantes: Spread pulley facing top to bottom

consignes.Positionnement: Pulleys at the bottom, slightly inclined bust.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise and bring towards the top/center (sternum/chin line).
consignes.Retour: Lower back down slowly in control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bringing it closer, inhale while opening.
consignes.Posture: Sheathed trunk, stable shoulder blades.

contraintes: Do not bounce on the chest
variantes: Pressed down with the guided machine

consignes.Positionnement: Lying on bench, hands slightly width > shoulders, shoulder blades together.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower the bar to the bottom of the pectorals in control.
consignes.Retour: Push without locking your elbows, stable trajectory.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Chest out, shoulders down, glutes in contact.

consignes.Positionnement: Inclined bench (30–45°), shoulder blades tight, grip stable.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend to the top of the pectorals/clavicles in control.
consignes.Retour: Push while keeping the trajectory stable.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Chest out, shoulders down.

contraintes: Do not peel off the back of the file
variantes: Pressed down with the guided machine

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, handles at the height of the pectorals, shoulder blades tight.
consignes.Mouvement: Push forward/up while controlling the trajectory.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to a controlled stretch.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pushing, inhale while returning.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders down, chest out.

T344.nom: Pressed down with the guided machine

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, handles slightly below the line of the pectorals.
consignes.Mouvement: Push forward with control.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly, comfortable amplitude.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pushing, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Chest out, shoulders low, trunk core.

contraintes: Do not take off your heels

consignes.Positionnement: Back on the backrest, feet hip width apart on the platform.
consignes.Mouvement: Go down by bending your knees in control.
consignes.Retour: Push without locking your knees.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale while going down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Strong sheathing, stable pelvis.

contraintes: Do not round your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Feet higher on the platform, toes slightly open.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend in control to a comfortable amplitude.
consignes.Retour: Push while keeping the pelvis stable.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Abs contracted, shoulders braced.

contraintes: Do not hyperextend your lower back

consignes.Positionnement: Back supported, pad on the pelvis, feet hip width apart.
consignes.Mouvement: Push the hips upwards while contracting the glutes.
consignes.Retour: Lower back down in control without completely releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.
consignes.Posture: Low rib cage, neutral pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, chest braced, handles grasped, shoulders low.
consignes.Mouvement: Bring your arms down by contracting your latissimus dorsi.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly while maintaining tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Engaged abs, long neck.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, back flat, handles in neutral grip, chest out.
consignes.Mouvement: Push forward following the converging trajectory.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return to a controlled stretch.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, active core, no rebound.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, pronated grip, elbows slightly below the shoulder line.
consignes.Mouvement: Push while maintaining control and converging trajectory.
consignes.Retour: Return to control without completely releasing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder blades tight, chest out.

consignes.Positionnement: Seat adjusted so that the handles are at the top of the pectorals.
consignes.Mouvement: Push forward/up following the converging path.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly, controlled stretch.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Chest out, shoulders down, core.

consignes.Positionnement: Chest against the support, handles grasped, elbows slightly bent.
consignes.Mouvement: Open your arms backwards, squeezing your shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without losing tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale when opening, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, long neck.

consignes.Positionnement: Fixed belt, stable feet, straight torso.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower into a squat while keeping your back neutral.
consignes.Retour: Push with control, without locking your knees.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing, stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Shoulders under the pads, feet stable, trunk covered.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend in control, guided trajectory.
consignes.Retour: Push hard without locking your knees.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale at the bottom, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, heels on the floor.

consignes.Positionnement: Tibia supported/assisted, trunk braced, heels on the ground if possible.
consignes.Mouvement: Lower back, letting your knees move forward (control).
consignes.Retour: Go back up by strongly contracting the quadriceps.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the way down, exhale on the way up.
consignes.Posture: Neutral pelvis, no jerks.

consignes.Positionnement: Chest against the pad, neutral grip, back braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull the handles towards the abdomen while squeezing the shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Slowly return with outstretched arms without lifting your chest.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Long neck, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Chest braced, overhand grip, arms straight.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull by opening your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without losing contact with the pad.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling, inhale when returning.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, neck aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Chest braced, one active arm at a time.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull your elbow back, controlling the rotation.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly with your arms outstretched.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, shoulders low.

contraintes: Do not pull with your arms

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, chest out, neutral grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull down starting from the elbows.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly with arms outstretched.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, active sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, supinated grip, chest extended.
consignes.Mouvement: Pull down, keeping your elbows close to your chest.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly with arms outstretched.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while pulling.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, active sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: Seated, back flat, handles in neutral grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Push upwards without locking your elbows.
consignes.Retour: Lower slowly to a comfortable amplitude.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale on the push, inhale on the return.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing, aligned neck.

consignes.Positionnement: Sit, pronated grip, elbows slightly under the handles.
consignes.Mouvement: Push vertically in control.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without releasing the tension.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Flat back, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Sitting, one arm active, trunk braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Push vertically without compensation.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis stable, shoulders low.

consignes.Positionnement: Arms supported on the pads, shoulders low.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your arms sideways until horizontal.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Long neck, stable trunk.

consignes.Positionnement: One arm at a time, core stable.
consignes.Mouvement: Lift sideways without momentum.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, neck aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Arms placed on the desk, neutral grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Bend your elbows without lifting your arms.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly while controlling.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bending.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders down, bust still.

consignes.Positionnement: Arms braced, supinated grip.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise the load by contracting the biceps.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Stable bust, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: One arm at a time, arm braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Flex without compensating.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Elbows braced, handles grabbed.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your elbows without locking.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at extension.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders, stable bust.

consignes.Positionnement: One arm at a time, elbow braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend the elbow without compensation.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at extension.
consignes.Posture: Low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Forearms braced, wrists free.
consignes.Mouvement: Flex your wrists while contracting your forearms.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bending.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders relaxed.

consignes.Positionnement: Forearms braced, palms down.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend your wrists slowly.
consignes.Retour: Get back in control.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at extension.
consignes.Posture: Cuffs aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Heavy loads in each hand.
consignes.Mouvement: Maintain the grip without moving.
consignes.Retour: Rest under control.
consignes.Respiration: Calm breathing.
consignes.Posture: Straight bust, low shoulders.

consignes.Positionnement: Pelvis supported, back neutral.
consignes.Mouvement: Extend the torso while keeping the spine aligned.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale at extension.
consignes.Posture: Do not hyperextend.

consignes.Positionnement: Pelvis propped up, legs dangling.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs into hip extension.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly without momentum.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, active sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: One active leg, thigh braced.
consignes.Mouvement: Flex the knee without compensation.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale while bending.
consignes.Posture: Stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Shoulders under the pads, points on the platform.
consignes.Mouvement: Stand on tiptoe.
consignes.Retour: Slowly lower below horizontal.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Straight bust.

consignes.Positionnement: Knees under the pads, feet on the platform.
consignes.Mouvement: Maximum ankle extension.
consignes.Retour: Slow and controlled descent.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Straight back.

consignes.Positionnement: Plated back, gripped handles.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll your torso forward.
consignes.Retour: Return slowly without releasing.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you roll up.
consignes.Posture: Relaxed neck.

consignes.Positionnement: Forearms on the ground, load on the back.
consignes.Mouvement: Isometric hold.
consignes.Retour: Rest under control.
consignes.Respiration: Calm breathing.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back.

consignes.Positionnement: One active side, flat back.
consignes.Mouvement: Roll up with slight rotation.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you roll up.
consignes.Posture: Stable pelvis.

consignes.Positionnement: Elbow under the shoulder, load on the hip.
consignes.Mouvement: Isometric hold.
consignes.Retour: Rest under control.
consignes.Respiration: Calm breathing.
consignes.Posture: Body aligned.

consignes.Positionnement: Stand with the machine on its side.
consignes.Mouvement: Push your arms in front of you without rotating.
consignes.Retour: Bring back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Active sheathing.

consignes.Positionnement: An active arm, sheathed body.
consignes.Mouvement: Push without deviation.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Basin locked.

consignes.Positionnement: Forearms placed, trunk covered.
consignes.Mouvement: Raise your legs without swinging.
consignes.Retour: Go back down slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you rise.
consignes.Posture: Pelvis in retroversion.

consignes.Positionnement: Load stuck to the bust.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk while maintaining the sheathing.
consignes.Retour: Rest under control.
consignes.Respiration: Controlled breathing.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back.

consignes.Positionnement: Load tight against the torso.
consignes.Mouvement: Walk without arching.
consignes.Retour: Controlled rest.
consignes.Respiration: Active breathing.
consignes.Posture: Straight back.

consignes.Positionnement: Kettlebell between the legs.
consignes.Mouvement: Hip extension + rack rise + press.
consignes.Retour: Controlled.
consignes.Respiration: Exhale as you push.
consignes.Posture: Constant gain.

consignes.Positionnement: Dumbbells overhead, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend controlled then push vertically.
consignes.Retour: Arms extended without locking.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder blades tight, feet grounded.

consignes.Positionnement: Dumbbells overhead, palms facing each other.
consignes.Mouvement: Descend controlled then push vertically.
consignes.Retour: Arms extended without locking.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Shoulder blades tight, feet grounded.

consignes.Positionnement: Incline bench, dumbbells at upper pectoral level.
consignes.Mouvement: Push upwards without hitting the dumbbells.
consignes.Retour: Lower slowly, elbows under control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, feet anchored.

consignes.Positionnement: Incline bench, dumbbells at upper pectoral level.
consignes.Mouvement: Push upwards without hitting the dumbbells.
consignes.Retour: Lower slowly, elbows under control.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale down, exhale while pushing up.
consignes.Posture: Neutral back, feet anchored.

consignes.Positionnement: Flat back, handles at lower pectoral height.
consignes.Mouvement: Push while keeping your elbows under control.
consignes.Retour: Come back slowly.
consignes.Respiration: Inhale on the return, exhale on the push.
consignes.Posture: Shoulders low, chest open.
